office_does: The prosecuting attorney runs the Clark County Prosecuting Attorney's Office, which charges and prosecutes felonies countywide and misdemeanors in unincorporated areas, and is the county government's civil lawyer.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Senior Deputy Prosecutor Laurel Smith is the only candidate for this open office.

candidates.summary: Senior deputy prosecutor in the Clark County Prosecuting Attorney's Office since 2012, supervising domestic violence and child abuse units; the only candidate.
highlights: Clark County deputy prosecutor since 2012, supervising specialized units including domestic violence and child abuse [S1]
Judge pro tempore in Clark County District Court since 2022 [S1]
Pledges to hold offenders accountable while using 'smart, evidence-based approaches' [S1]
